title: receiveTypingIndicators polarity inverted vs muted
description: Chat.muted uses affirmative-suppression polarity (true = suppress), while Chat.receiveTypingIndicators uses affirmative-enablement polarity (false = suppress). A client setting both preferences must remember that false means suppress for one field and true means suppress for the other. The consistent pattern used by muted/blocked throughout the spec is 'affirmative flag that activates the non-default behavior'; receiveTypingIndicators breaks this by defaulting to true and requiring false to activate suppression. Consider renaming to muteTypingIndicators (Boolean, default false) to match the muted/blocked pattern.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
